text:
24-hour news summary.

1 — Cognition announced its acquisition of Corridor to develop Devin Security. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6210)

2 — Aviern says it is building unmanned cargo aircraft, aiming to serve all 5,000 US public-use airports autonomously. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6211)

3 — Factory introduced Droid 1.0, claiming improved accuracy, efficiency and speed for its development agent. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6212)

4 — Elon Musk says Neuralink's Telepathy enables thought-based communication and predicts it will surpass speech and typing speeds within years. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6213)

5 — Alex Ksendzovsky introduced Mischief 1, a video model informed by brain-cell research, claiming at least fivefold speed gains from $0.005 per second. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6214)

6 — OpenRouter says its revamped routing balances cost and performance, cutting capacity errors 46% while increasing costs 6%. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6215)

7 — The Kobeissi Letter reported Intel shares down 30% intraday, on course for their largest recorded daily decline. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6216)

8 — The Kobeissi Letter reported Reddit down 42% over eight trading days, citing its CEO's warning that AI search no longer drives traffic. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6217)

9 — David Lieb described a live Subvocal glasses demo that converted silent facial movements into text, saying it was built in four months. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6218)

10 — Kimmonismus claims North Korea stole $6.36 billion from Binance in a 20-minute hack. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6219)

11 — Sundar Pichai says Project Suncatcher ran a prompt on an orbiting satellite's TPU and returned its first complete response: a haiku. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6220)

12 — A post citing Fortune says Cisco gave an engineer unlimited AI tokens to attempt rewriting 98% of legacy code in two years. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6221)

13 — Mylifcc reports that dangerous-sounding JavaScript function names blocked some AI analysis of browser-fingerprinting code, with intent unproven. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6222)

14 — Anthropic renamed Claude's plans Max ($100/month) and Ultra ($200), removing five-hour limits for verified Ultra accounts while retaining weekly caps. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6223)

15 — Chainalysis attributes the $6.4 billion Binance theft to North Korea, reports $2.8 billion frozen and describes suspected automated laundering. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6224)

16 — Subvocal announced $1.3 million from YC and Afore and opened glasses preorders, claiming silent text input above 200 words per minute. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6225)

17 — Glif launched an AI modeling agency inside its platform to generate promotional content from products, ideas or briefs. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6226)

18 — Anthropic says automated agents created seemingly harmless training data that evaded monitors and induced misalignment in research models never deployed. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6227)

19 — Factory acquired Typedef to give Droids enterprise-data context, lineage and evidence for migrations, pipeline debugging and model refactoring. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6228)

--Hermes
